Quick summary

The cloud GIS market is projected to grow from $1.97 billion in 2025 to $2.36 billion in 2026 (19.5% CAGR) and reach $4.76 billion by 2030, driven by smart city projects, AI-powered geospatial analytics, and growing cloud infrastructure.

Key takeaways

  • The cloud GIS market grew from $1.97 billion in 2025 to a projected $2.36 billion in 2026, a CAGR of 19.5%
  • By 2030, the market is expected to reach $4.76 billion at a CAGR of 19.2%
  • Growth drivers include smart city projects, AI-powered geospatial analytics, climate monitoring programs, and location-based services
  • Key market players include Google, Microsoft, Amazon Web Services, Hexagon, Autodesk, Trimble, Maxar, Bentley Systems, Here Technologies, Mapbox, and CartoDB
  • Market segments span hardware, software, and services across functions like mapping, surveying, location-based services, and navigation
  • Applications range from watershed management and risk management to urban planning, defense management, and building information modeling
